Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the clear asks. I pulled together an initial playbook below — attaching a concise evidence intake checklist and DPA redline status for Legal. High level: we can provide scoped SOC 2 artifact bundles for the eval within 3 business days of a formal request (standard artifacts and a shared-read-only folder), SIG/CAIQ baseline materials (architecture diagrams + control mappings) in 5 business days, and we propose a 90-day default staging retention window with options to shorten to 30 days for test traffic if Eventline requests.

Summary (full details and links below):
- SOC 2: we share the Type II report and a scoped evidence folder. For requested control artifacts (logs, runbooks, test results) we deliver within 3 business days; secure access via our temporary S3 presigned links or shared Drive (access audit logged).
- SIG/CAIQ: baseline CAIQ and network diagram attached; advanced items (pentest reports, infra config) require 5 business days to collate.
- DPA: Legal has prepared a redline (attached) with EU residency and deletion obligations (we support EU region pinning for production; for POC/staging we can discuss masked/resident options).
- Retention model: default staging retention = 90 days; masked logs option and auto-purge policy available at 30/60/90-day buckets. We recommend 30 days if you want minimal footprint during evaluation.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll assign Kimberly to run the SOC 2 evidence intake and provide a timeline for each requested file.
2) Neha will coordinate with Legal on the DPA redline and follow up on any carveouts for data residency/escrow.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-minute handoff call (internal + your Security + Legal) to walk the playbook and confirm timelines.

I’ve attached: evidence-intake-checklist.pdf and DPA_redline_Eventline_v2.docx. Let me know which retention bucket you prefer for the POC.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: SOC 2 evidence intake — proposed cadence and access controls

Sofia —

Quick note from the SOC 2 side. I reviewed your questionnaire and mapped the asks to a minimal intake cadence so you can plan the MAP acceptance gates.

Proposed cadence:
- Day 0 (formal intake): Eventline submits the evidence checklist (you already started this).
- Day 1–3: Redwood compiles and uploads scoped artifacts to a read-only folder (audit logging enabled). Typical artifacts: system description, control narratives for logical access, change management, incident response, and selected sample logs (redacted where necessary).
- Day 4–5: If Eventline requests deep-dive artifacts (e.g., raw audit trails), we require a signed NDA addendum + brief justification; delivery within 5 business days conditional on that.

Access controls & redaction guidance:
- We provide redacted logs by default for POC sharing and can provide tokenized datasets on request.
- Temporary access links expire after 14 days. All accesses are logged and available for your audit team.

Acceptance gate recommendation for the MAP:
- MAP security gate #1 (evidence available): SOC 2 artifact bundle uploaded and Eventline confirms artifact review within 7 business days.
- MAP security gate #2 (no open control deficiencies): Any findings requiring remediation are documented with owners and ETA; if high-severity, we recommend a mitigation plan before production signoff.

I’ll prepare the folder and send the link once Dylan confirms the intake items. Jordan — looping you for the mutual action plan timeline and the MAP milestone that ties to contract close.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Security intake + archival windows for MAP — DPA & retention confirmation

Hi all —

Short update from Legal on the DPA redline and retention carveouts:
- We included an explicit 90-day staging retention default and an optional 30-day reduced retention addendum for POCs. If Eventline elects 30-day retention, we will require data-masking on identifiers for any shared logs (we recommend the masking approach outlined in section 3.2 of the attached DPA).
- EU residency: for production we support EU-region pinning; for evaluation we can provide masked EU-resident test data on a best-effort basis (we do not spin dedicated EU hardware for short POCs unless there is a purchase/commitment).
- Escrow/long-term archive: if Eventline requires archival beyond 12 months for regulatory reasons, we have an add-on for encrypted archival with HSM key options — I can provide costs if needed.

Action items:
- Sofia: confirm whether Eventline wants 30-day masked retention for the POC or the 90-day default.
- Dylan/Kimberly: please upload the SOC 2 artifact bundle and the CAIQ/network diagram link by EOD Wednesday so Eventline can slot review time into the MAP.
- Jordan: can you propose the MAP milestone dates (evidence upload, review window, hold-for-signoff) so we can align contracting milestones to the MAP?

I’ll stay on the thread for any Legal clarifications.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
